tools.name: estimate_refund
tools.description: Estimate the reclaimable withholding tax on one dividend or interest payment for a source/residence country pair, with the treaty rate, filing form and deadline. Country codes are ISO alpha-2; payment_date is YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List supported source and residence countries, domestic withholding rates and the payment years that may still be reclaimable.

tools.name: get_deadline
tools.description: Get the withholding-tax reclaim deadline rule for a source country, optionally for a specific residence (treaty partner) country.

tools.name: estimate_dividends
tools.description: Estimate the reclaimable withholding tax for a whole dividend history in one call: send either a broker export as csv_text with its broker id, or a list of payments (ISIN, payment_date YYYY-MM-DD, gross_amount, currency, optional withheld_amount), max 500. Returns each payment with its source countr
